tooling.message:
docs(agents): agents reply in plain language as per ISO 24495

## Intent

Agents working in the lernapps repositories should reply in plain language. ISO 24495 (Plain language) names the principles: the reader finds what they need, understands it and can use it.

## Key changes

- AGENTS.md holds the instruction "Reply as per ISO 24495" for every agent that reads it.
- CLAUDE.md imports AGENTS.md, because Claude Code reads only CLAUDE.md.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Every platform repository gets the same two files: app-templates ec64acc, apps 46144a8, lernapps.github.io 2eab101, docs a8d5632, .github a5ddfb2.
